'''Queen Yram's Needle''' was a narrow [[Color/Legends|white]] obelisk built in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It bore the name of [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Yram/Legends|Yram]], a member of the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal House of Naboo]].<ref name="Inside" /> Between [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]] and [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], in his public guise as businessman Hego Damask, took a walk through Theed with the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] youth [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Their tour included a walk along the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]] in the direction of Queen Yram's Needle and the [[Concert Hall/Legends|Concert Hall]] before crossing a footbridge towards the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Queen Yram's Needle was first mentioned and pictured in ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'', a [[2000]] reference book by [[Kristin Lund]].<ref name="Inside" /> It first appeared in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']] by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />
